notes.title: Bundles of sales, with Twin Sails and Acram Digital
notes.content:
We at Twin Sails Interactive are ecstatic to bring you an exclusive Steam bundle in partnership with Acram Digital! Get Dawnmaker and Carcassonne together at a massively reduced price for a limited time only!

[h2]Don't miss out on getting these two Must-Have Strategy Games:[/h2]
[list][*] [b]Dawnmaker[/b]: Shape the future in this innovative strategy game, where every decision crafts a unique world of possibilities.
[*] [b]Carcassonne[/b]: Build medieval landscapes, claim cities, and strategically place your followers in this timeless tile-placement classic.[/list]

notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
Greetings, city builders!
 
Here is a minor update after your last feedback. 
 
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a bug that reset game statistics in certain circumstances
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented saving the chosen Meeple's colors[/list]

[b]This means that you will get back all the stats you have lost![/b]

Many thanks for all of your feedback. This proves to be a great help in improving the quality of Carcassonne!
 
Have a great game!

notes.title: New patch 1.10
notes.content:
Dear community,

we have worked on improving Carcassonne with bug fixing and several quality of life improvements, like the pretty useful "Meeple Outline"! 

[b]Here is the patchnote for this update:[/b]

[u]Bug fixes:[/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug when opening the achievements screen the first time
[*]Fixed a bug when exiting the current online game when another game is forfeited due to time-out.
[*]A corrupted save file no longer blocks the loading process but reset to default values
[*]Dragon phase do not play the correct number of turns if a player is swapped by a bot during online games (timed-out or replaced by auto-play) is fixed
[/list]

[u]Improvements:[/u]
[list]
[*]Adding the option "Meeple Outline"
[*]In-Game animations speed is adjustable (4 levels)
[*]Removal of option "Meeple bounce" toggle (always active)
[*]Option screen has been reworked with pictograms
[*]An indicator is displayed with different levels when the connection to the network  becomes unstable
[*]Greatly improved online connection stability
[*]Game no longer reload after a short connection loss or when resuming from background
[*]Online game chat history is available when resuming an online game
[*]Optimized performance of the chat screen (lobby and in-game) for low-end devices
[*]AI performance optimization when playing with the "Inns & Cathedrals" expansion
[*]Significant AI performance optimization during the dragon tiles placement when playing with the "Princess & Dragon" expansion
[/list]


Thank you very much for all your feedback and have fun playing Carcassonne!

notes.title: Patch 1.5.1
notes.content:
Dear community

Here are changes to notice in this patch :

Private games enhancement 
-Invitation system has been improved.
-You can now send a notification to unconnected buddies to invite them in a private lobby.
-Set a lobby duration to avoid waiting for too long, or simply delete your lobby.
Also includes 
-fixed incompatibility with Steam windows 32 bits configuration


Let us know what you think!

Let us know if you find any other problems!

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Dear community,

We heard you and worked hard on a 2nd patch for Carcassonne.
This patch fixes the following issues:

- Some connectivity and login issue. If you still encounter bugs on this topic, please contact us directly.
- 4K compatibility: you can now play on your 4K screen with a maximu resolution of 1920x1080. This is not a full 4K support, but the game is now running on such monitors.
- Chat message are now received and sent correctly.
- The Hot bot swap option for multiplayer games is now by default on Off, allowing you to quit the game without being replaced by an AI. This option can of course be reactivated in the game creation options.

Let us know what you think about this patch.

Asmodee team
